{
  "candidate_rtl": "module addr_calcu(
    input [7:0] address,
    input [7:0] ptr1, ptr2,
    input [7:0] b,
    input control,
    output [15:0] count
);

    parameter [7:0] base = 8'b10000000;

    wire [7:0] selected_pointer;
    wire [7:0] offset;
    wire [7:0] inverted_offset;
    wire [7:0] csa_sum, csa_carry;
    wire [8:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    wire [8:0] p0, g0;
    wire [8:0] p1, g1, p2, g2, p4, g4, p8, g8;
    wire [9:0] carry;
    wire [9:0] total;
    wire negative_result;

    assign selected_pointer = control ? ptr1 : ptr2;

    // This assignment deliberately preserves the required 8-bit wrap.
    assign offset = base - selected_pointer;
    assign inverted_offset = ~offset;

    // Carry-save compression of three unsigned 8-bit operands.
    assign csa_sum = address ^ b ^ inverted_offset;
    assign csa_carry = (address & b) |
                       (address & inverted_offset) |
                       (b & inverted_offset);
    assign operand_a = {1'b0, csa_sum};
    assign operand_b = {csa_carry, 1'b0};

    // Nine-bit parallel-prefix addition with carry-in equal to one.
    assign p0 = operand_a ^ operand_b;
    assign g0 = operand_a & operand_b;

    assign g1 = g0 | (p0 & (g0 << 1));
    assign p1 = p0 & ((p0 << 1) | 9'b000000001);
    assign g2 = g1 | (p1 & (g1 << 2));
    assign p2 = p1 & ((p1 << 2) | 9'b000000011);
    assign g4 = g2 | (p2 & (g2 << 4));
    assign p4 = p2 & ((p2 << 4) | 9'b000001111);
    assign g8 = g4 | (p4 & (g4 << 8));
    assign p8 = p4 & ((p4 << 8) | 9'b011111111);

    assign carry = {g8 | p8, 1'b1};
    assign total = {carry[9], (p0 ^ carry[8:0])};

    // total = address + b + (255-offset) + 1.
    // Therefore count = total - 256, modulo 65536.
    assign negative_result = ~(total[9] | total[8]);
    assign count = {{7{negative_result}}, ~total[8], total[7:0]};

endmodule",

Resolve the result with an explicit nine-bit parallel-prefix adder and carry-in one. Recover the 16-bit subtraction result through upper-byte decoding rather than a separate wide subtractor. This shares the arithmetic between the two pointer choices and offers a shallow carry-resolution structure.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "A hypothesis, not a measurement: carry-save compression followed by prefix carry resolution may shorten the maximum data-arrival path, while removing the final wide mux may also help. Moving selection before offset generation adds a mux to the pointer path, and ABC may restructure the prefix network, so improvement is not guaranteed. No mapped-area or electrical-check result is available for this candidate. Acceptance requires mapped area at or below 1311.632960 um^2, full functional equivalence, and zero max-slew/max-capacitance violations under the fixed constraints.",
  "functional_boundaries": "The module name, ports, widths, and parameter declaration/default are preserved. No state, clocks, assumptions, or don't-cares are introduced. Every one of the 33 ordinary input bits remains unconstrained. Offset is explicitly (base-selected_pointer) modulo 256. For every input, total equals address+b+256-offset and lies in 1..766. Subtracting 256 leaves the low byte unchanged; its upper byte is FF, 00, or 01 when total[9:8] is 00, 01, or 10, respectively, exactly matching the output decoding. Thus count is (zero_extended_address-zero_extended_offset+zero_extended_b) modulo 65536. The algebra also preserves other 8-bit base parameter values, although only the default instance is assessed."
